title: 🎬 COUNT YOURSELF BLESSED 🎬 If you have a spouse who stands beside you in the work of the ministry — count yourself truly blessed. 💍
paragraphs:
🎬 COUNT YOURSELF BLESSED 🎬
If you have a spouse who stands beside you in the work of the ministry — count yourself truly blessed. 💍
Not everyone gets to serve God with their best friend, prayer partner, and biggest encourager all in one. 🙏

💖 Love isn’t just about romance — it’s about partnership in purpose.
Every prayer, every late night, every moment of faith… together.

“Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
If either of them falls down, one can help the other up.”
— Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 (NIV)
Let them know — they are your blessing. 💫
